_comment: ChatterApply profile. Keys are the app's own question ids, taken from its bundle:
npm run apply:fill -- --tenant <slug> --discover   prints them for any screen.
A key with no value is left alone; a REQUIRED one with no value stops the run and names the
question instead of guessing. The desk photo is attached as a file, never typed.
The speed and typing tests are not values: the speed test is run by the page, and the typing
test is yours unless you pass --include-typing --typing-wpm 70.
